skills.description: Look up United States legal doctrine on digest.law, the American Legal Digest — free, open (CC BY 4.0), source-grounded topic digests across every major area of law, each with its retained sources, authorities and an audit trail. Use this skill whenever a task touches US law — a legal research question, a memo or brief, a contract or compliance question, checking what a doctrine or rule says, finding leading cases or statutes on an issue — even if the user never mentions digest.law. It tells you how to find a topic (MCP server or the area list), read it as markdown, and cite it with a permanent identifier.
skills.name: american-legal-digest
